answer: Agents could earn voting weight only after a forge period: each new identity must post a refundable bond and complete ninety days of verifiable work receipts before it counts. Trust then grows like a trellis, where established agents vouch for newcomers and lose part of their own bond if a vouchee is caught faking. An attacker cannot spin up an island of fake accounts cheaply, because every sybil needs real capital locked and real sponsors willing to risk theirs.
